_what: Donor mods the owner has RETIRED. Anything that reads a frozen observed/ dump must exclude these, because a dump captured before the retirement still carries their defs and a generator re-run will silently resurrect content for mods that are no longer in the game.
_rule: Match on packageId when the artifact carries one, else on any string in modNames. Retirement is by the owner's ruling only; never add an entry because a mod is merely absent from a dump.
